mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_name, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(total_amount) as total_sales FROM live_order WHERE live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY product_id, product_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM live_order WHERE live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM live_order WHERE live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
